description: In front of you on the bed are a white plastic bench/chair-like frame with an X-brace and a couple of small white block pieces nearby. The left hand stays near the base to steady the frame while the right hand reaches to the top of the frame, grips a small white cap-like piece, lifts it up and off, then moves down and places it on the bed to the right, leaving the frame upright without that top piece.
